data.question: What services does Bricknbath provide?
data.answer:
Bricknbath offers complete bathroom renovation solutions, including: 
•Bathroom design consultation  
•Demolition and removal of existing fixtures  
•Tiling work  
•Plumbing modifications  
•Electrical and lighting upgrades  
•Installation of Sanitaryware and Bath fittings  
•Glass partition installation  
•Final finishing and quality inspection

data.question: What is Bricknbath?
data.answer:
Bricknbath is a specialized bathroom renovation service powered by Bricknbar. We transform 
old, outdated bathrooms into modern, functional, and luxurious spaces through professionally 
managed renovation packages.

data.question: How do I book a bathroom renovation consultation?
data.answer:
Booking a consultation is simple: 
•Call us at 1800-212-0151
•Visit Bricknbath.com  
•Submit your requirements through our website  
Our renovation experts will contact you to discuss your project and schedule a site visit if 
required.

data.question: Which cities do you currently serve?
data.answer:
Our service availability depends on the project location. Please contact our team to confirm 
whether renovation services are available in your city.

data.question: Is there any warranty on renovation work?
data.answer:
Yes. We stand behind the quality of our workmanship. Warranty terms may vary depending 
on the renovation package and products selected. Our team will provide complete warranty 
details before project execution.

data.question: Do you offer luxury bathroom renovation packages?
data.answer:
Yes. Bricknbath specializes in premium and luxury bathroom transformations featuring high-
end finishes, modern lighting, designer fittings, elegant glass partitions, and customized 
design solutions.

data.question: Do you provide design consultation before renovation?
data.answer:
Yes. Our experts assess your existing bathroom, understand your requirements, and 
recommend layouts, materials, fixtures, and finishes that best match your style and budget.

data.question: How long does a bathroom renovation take?
data.answer:
Most bathroom renovation projects are completed within 7 to 21 days, depending on the 
complexity of the work and the materials selected.

data.question: How much does a bathroom renovation cost?
data.answer:
The renovation cost depends on factors such as bathroom size, scope of work, product 
selection, and design preferences. We offer multiple renovation packages to suit different 
budgets and requirements. Contact us for a customized quotation.

data.question: Can I choose my own products for renovation?
data.answer:
Yes. You can either select products from Bricknbar's extensive collection or choose products 
based on your design preferences and budget. Our experts will help ensure compatibility with 
your renovation requirements.

data.question: How can I purchase bathroom products?
data.answer:
You can explore and purchase bathroom products through Bricknbar: 
•Website: https://bricknbar.com  
•Phone: +91 97777 72782  
Our team can also guide you in selecting products suitable for your renovation project.

data.question: Do you sell bathroom products directly through Bricknbath?
data.answer:
Bricknbath - Powered by Bricknbar primarily focuses on bathroom renovation services. 
For purchasing bathroom products such as sanitaryware, faucets, bath fittings, tiles, bathtubs, 
vanities, mirrors, and accessories, please visit Bricknbar's website or contact our team for 
assistance.
